remarks: Charming Mid Century Modern home located in a wonderful Sierra Madre neighborhood. The formal entry opens to large living with cathedral ceiling and expansive mountain views. Step down to the open floor plan with formal dining area and family room. There's a modern, well-appointed kitchen with ample cupboard and storage space, and a laundry room. The large primary bedroom has built-in closets and an en suite 3/4 bathroom. Bedrooms 2  &  3 have large built-in closets and share a full bathroom.
